communication.evidence:
event_index 1: "Our support policy doesn’t cover converting an existing order payment into monthly instalments, so I can’t confirm whether it’s available or what the terms would be. I’ll refer your question to a human support specialist for clarification."

and event_index 13: "Your enquiry about monthly instalments for **O0007 (Cotton kurta)** has been queued for human support.\n\n**Reference: H0001.** Instalment availability and terms are still unconfirmed, and no changes have been made to your payment."

values.user_request: Customer wants to convert the payment for order O0007 (Cotton kurta) into monthly instalments and asks whether this is possible and how it would work.
values.facts_found: Identity verified for U014 using registered email. O0007 belongs to U014. Order placed 2026-09-02 and delivered 2026-09-07 at 12:00 IST. Item I0007 is Cotton kurta, quantity 1, database price ₹1,499; shipping_fee ₹49; total ₹1,548. Payment method is UPI. Refund history shows no refunds on this order and zero qualifying refunds in the last 90 days. Order data records an uploaded evidence photo, but no return or damage claim is being made. Existing-payment conversion to monthly instalments is not covered by Cartly Support Policy v0.6. No payment or order changes have been made.
values.rule_triggered: A3: Policy does not cover converting an existing order payment to monthly instalments; escalate rather than invent a rule. G3: Relevant readable facts gathered for handoff.
values.what_user_was_told: Confirmed that O0007 was paid by UPI. Explained that converting an existing payment to instalments is not covered by our support policy and that the order details are being passed to human support to check whether it is possible and what the terms would be. No eligibility or terms were promised.
